user.title: Connect to SberHome
user.description: Choose how to authorize with Sber smart home.

sms_phone.title: Sign in via SMS (beta)
sms_phone.description: Enter the phone number registered with Sber Home. Format: {example_phone}. We'll send a one-time SMS code.

sms_otp.title: Enter the SMS code
sms_otp.description: We sent a one-time code to {phone}.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The SberHome authorization token has expired. Please sign in again ({method}).

abort.wrong_account: Signed in with a different Sber account than the original config entry. Sign in again with the correct account.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sber servers. Check the connection and try again.
abort.no_url_available: No accessible Home Assistant URL is configured. Set an external or internal URL in Settings → System → Network and try again.

error.invalid_phone: Invalid phone number. Use international format like 78001234567.
error.send_otp_failed: Could not send the SMS code. Verify the number and try again later.
error.invalid_otp: The SMS code is wrong or expired. Request a new one if needed.

create_entry.default: Authorization successful. **No devices were imported automatically** — open the SberHome panel in the sidebar (or go to [/sberhome](/sberhome)) and pick which devices you want in Home Assistant. Until then the integration is connected but exposes no entities.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the API while the WebSocket is down (10 to 3600 seconds). While it is connected, device states arrive instantly and the API is polled every 10 minutes.
data_description.devtools_buffer_size: How many entries each DevTools log in the panel keeps: messages, state changes, commands, validation issues (10 to 5000).
data_description.command_timeout: How long to wait for a device to report the commanded state before the panel marks the command unconfirmed (1 to 120 seconds).

send_custom_key.name: Send custom key
send_custom_key.description: Send a custom key press (confirm/back/home) to a SberHome TV.

send_direction.name: Send direction
send_direction.description: Send a D-pad direction (up/down/left/right) to a SberHome TV.

play_channel.name: Play channel
play_channel.description: Switch to a specific channel number on a SberHome TV.

conflicting_integration.title: Detected another Sber integration
conflicting_integration.description: Two integrations for Sber devices are installed: SberHome and {domains}. Running two integrations against the same Sber account at once can cause conflicts — intercepted state updates, incorrect mode display, command races. It is recommended to keep only one of them enabled.

update_failing.title: SberHome cannot update devices
update_failing.description: The last {count} updates from the Sber cloud failed. Last error: {error}. Devices keep their last known state. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant; if the error mentions authorization, re-authenticate the integration.

background_poll_disabled.title: SberHome stopped some background updates
background_poll_disabled.description: These background updates were turned off after an error: {polls}. Device control still works, but scenarios, firmware or speaker data may be out of date. Press Refresh in the SberHome panel or reload the integration to turn them back on.

multiple_config_entries.title: Several SberHome entries: the panel manages only one
multiple_config_entries.description: SberHome supports one Sber account per Home Assistant, but there are {count} SberHome entries now. The SberHome panel works only with the "{active}" entry. The other entries ({others}) cannot be managed from the panel: you cannot pick their devices and they are not shown there. Entities they already have keep working until you delete those entries. Home Assistant does not remove extra entries by itself and no longer lets you add a new one. Delete the extra entries in Settings → Devices & services → SberHome. If you need a different account, delete all SberHome entries and add the integration again, signing in with that account.

access_denied.message: Sber cloud denied access to this object: it may have been deleted in the Salute app. The integration will re-check the account data.

auth_failed.message: Sber cloud rejected the SberHome credentials. Sign in again: a reauthentication request has been added to Settings → Devices & services.

rate_limited.message: Sber cloud is limiting the request rate. Try again in a minute.

command_rejected.message: Sber cloud rejected the command as invalid (HTTP {status}). Check the value you are trying to set.

api_error.message: Sber cloud returned an error (HTTP {status}). Try again later.

cloud_unreachable.message: Sber cloud is unreachable. Check the Home Assistant internet connection and try again.

cloud_error.message: Sber cloud returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
